name: Create the thinker in the Referee
route: POST /api/thinkers {name, scholar_profile_url?} · POST /api/thinker-folders/{folder_id}/recruit-author (citing author → thinker + harvest) · POST /api/thinker-folders/bulk-add (many names with context)
cost_note: 1–2 cheap LLM calls (disambiguation + bio); Scholar pages only when a profile URL is given
side_effects: a thinker row (status pending → disambiguated); the profile route seeds works
gated_by: none (the row); discovery/harvest that follow are gated
